status_rule: main/pr27 entries are source or prior live observations, never an overall acceptance. Every row remains open until its acceptance journey passes on the chosen release and consumers.
consumer_rule: IDs refer to dependency-inventory.json. A listed ID identifies a migration cohort or confirmed use, not proof that every member calls every symbol in the row.

capabilities.name: 启动、隔离、复用与关闭
capabilities.contract: Unnamed starts are ephemeral and never reused; named profiles persist and reuse only matching identity. Explicit port and startup timeout bound launch; failed attempts must not leak Chrome. Stop inside an event loop must close cleanly.
capabilities.main: Lifecycle functions exist; current Windows debug CLI fails before browser dispatch (coverage-audit.md).
capabilities.pr27: Real Chrome start/stop worked in prior review; cross-workspace, cold start, profile contention and orphan cleanup are not accepted.
capabilities.acceptance: Start two unnamed sessions, change different pages, prove independent ports/tabs; restart named profiles and verify cookies; inject bind/startup failure and verify owned PID cleanup. Repeat on Windows/macOS/Linux.

capabilities.name: 浏览器发现、所有权与清理
capabilities.contract: GUID registry and process/CDP evidence identify ownership; workspace cleanup scope must be explicit. Missing psutil reduces observability and must be reported. Reserved Windows ports are excluded.
capabilities.main: Inventory uses command-line/CDP assumptions that need review against stealth launch; no proof of current registry parity.
capabilities.pr27: Native sysinfo inventory documented; real foreign-process and stale-registry cleanup not accepted.
capabilities.acceptance: Keep a foreign browser, owned idle browser and active browser alive; enumerate, dry-run cleanup and execute scoped cleanup; prove only eligible owned PIDs close, including stale entries and missing optional inventory dependency.

capabilities.name: 配置、代理与语言身份
capabilities.contract: Explicit args/environment/default precedence is per entry point. Proxy participates in reuse identity and persists for later calls; lang reports the landed setting. Chrome path, headless old/new, port and timeout envs are part of deployment behavior.
capabilities.main: Config and browser flags exist; source-level declarations do not prove precedence or cross-call state.
capabilities.pr27: Documents an intentional browser_connect transport-precedence change. Its old reference predates the locale result fix.
capabilities.acceptance: Run separate CLI processes with conflicting explicit/env values; inspect actual navigator language, proxy destination and reuse decisions, including unsupported flag values and headless modes.

capabilities.name: 扩展、连接、账号、弹窗与断开
capabilities.contract: Auto bridge startup, diagnostics, dedicated automation tab, tab/session routing, cookie shim, popup follow, MV3 worker revival and disconnect kill switch. Account/profile ownership is observable and must be chosen explicitly.
capabilities.main: Extension connection/disconnection command coverage missing at this baseline.
capabilities.pr27: Extension implementation and live suites present; one-profile ownership intentionally differs from Python newest-connection selection. Not rerun here against current reference routing/viewport fixes.
capabilities.acceptance: Install packaged extension in headed Chrome; discover/connect, use existing login, open popup and two tabs, navigate an OOPIF, suspend/revive worker, disconnect and verify subsequent control fails with useful diagnostics.

capabilities.name: 标签选择、状态与关闭计数
capabilities.contract: URL path matching takes precedence over query; active tab survives independent calls; injected browser_or_tab is not a shell flag. Close count reflects targets actually gone, not attempted closes; no_target is an actionable failure.
capabilities.main: Tab tools exist; latest close/routing semantics not accepted.
capabilities.pr27: Old baseline has tab tools, predates verified close count and injected-handle CLI fix.
capabilities.acceptance: Create URLs with overlapping query/path fragments, switch and read actual target across processes; close multiple matches including a refusing target and compare returned count with target disappearance.

capabilities.name: 导航、等待、对话框与焦点
capabilities.contract: Return URL/title/readiness after navigation; success means navigation issued, while ready independently reports load completion. ready=false does not imply navigation failed. Default dialog dismissal avoids hangs; explicit accept/dismiss/prompt and focus emulation need cross-call checks.
capabilities.main: Navigation/dialog functions exist; no current cross-process readiness acceptance.
capabilities.pr27: Basic real navigation passed; old reference predates honest ready-state and post-navigation URL corrections.
capabilities.acceptance: Navigate through redirect to delayed SPA, reload with dialog, wait for URL and document readiness; verify real DOM/state and bounded timeout, then handle prompt and read submitted value.

capabilities.name: 发现、AX/DOM 与 ref
capabilities.contract: Discovery is a bare list, includes DOM-only actions and numeric AX values. Ref carries frame/backend identity; visible wait must account for OOPIF target registration and scrolling.
capabilities.main: Discovery exists; same-name coverage does not prove iframe/ref lifetime equivalence.
capabilities.pr27: Basic form discovery/ref typing passed in prior live review; delayed OOPIF registration was added later in adb.
capabilities.acceptance: Discover a dynamic form with ARIA and DOM-only controls; pass returned ref directly to fill/click; repeat for same-origin, srcdoc and delayed cross-origin iframe, including stale ref after navigation.

capabilities.name: 文本、ID、XPath 定位与匹配
capabilities.contract: Accessible names, text, exact/fuzzy/regex and iframe scope are distinct. Optional rapidfuzz and private filter_recurse used by consumers require explicit migration decisions; missing/ambiguous match must remain actionable.
capabilities.main: Locator source exists, including a verbatim-copy provenance comment; see history-audit.md.
capabilities.pr27: Documents bounded fancy-regex rather than unrestricted Python regex. Exact/fuzzy/recursive behavior needs a compatibility decision and live corpus.
capabilities.acceptance: Find duplicate labels, aria-label controls, onclick-only nodes and nested iframe content; use returned match to act; compare regex/fuzzy edge cases and false positives, including absent optional dependency.

capabilities.name: 点击与结果确认
capabilities.contract: Trusted dispatch, scroll into view, ancestor/fallback ladder and bounded hangs; clicked/navigated/url_after reflect observed effects. Optional OS input is a separate platform capability.
capabilities.main: Click tools exist; no acceptance on latest fallback and failure semantics.
capabilities.pr27: Real form submit worked; missing target returned clicked=false with exit 0, confirmed mismatch with adb exit 4.
capabilities.acceptance: Discover and submit a real form; exercise nested scroll, obscured child, row action and hanging event handler; assert page effect, trusted event and failure exit/hint rather than returned boolean alone.

capabilities.name: 输入、按键和文本选择
capabilities.contract: Human/key events, clear/append/enter semantics, cross-platform selection and verified fallback on controlled inputs. Typed success requires actual value, not only dispatch success.
capabilities.main: Input tools exist; whole controlled-input journey not accepted.
capabilities.pr27: Basic ref fill passed; native OS-input and platform coverage are documented separately, not locally verified here.
capabilities.acceptance: Fill a controlled multilingual input, replace and append, select text then press shortcut/Enter; observe DOM value, input/change/key events and submitted server value across platforms.

capabilities.name: 鼠标、拖拽、滚动与人类化
capabilities.contract: CSS/screenshot coordinate conversion, held buttons, last position retained by the same Tab object (not proven across CLI processes), bounded human motion. Scroll reports actual movement separately from found; embedded-target fallback only for CDP -32601.
capabilities.main: Mouse/scroll functions exist; input state and result parity unaccepted.
capabilities.pr27: Live drag failed: buttons=0 and slider remained at 0px; Python moved 220px. --human-like flag gaps also found.
capabilities.acceptance: Use screenshot coordinates to drag a slider and click its result; assert trusted event buttons and final geometry. Scroll nested container to a row and verify movement; check embedded target fallback does not hide unrelated CDP errors.

capabilities.name: 元素级动作与上传
capabilities.contract: Discovered ref is the input to focus/hover/select/upload; element HTML and selection state are inspectable. Upload carries local file paths through CDP and must work in frame context.
capabilities.main: Same-name actions present; SDK Element methods exceed this CLI list.
capabilities.pr27: Actions present; actual upload/form-result and stale-ref recovery not accepted in this audit.
capabilities.acceptance: Discover a file input and select control inside a frame, upload temporary files, select an option and submit; verify server-received bytes and option, hover popup and actual focused element.

capabilities.name: 页面读取、JS 与跨 frame 执行
capabilities.contract: JS values serialize deeply; thrown/nonserializable results are errors, with console/expression context. Frame URL/name/srcdoc/OOPIF selection is explicit. Deterministic JS errors must not suggest blind replay.
capabilities.main: JS/page tools present, not accepted across frame and value/error domains.
capabilities.pr27: Real JS throw classified io/exit9 versus adb non-retryable exit1; basic DOM read worked.
capabilities.acceptance: Read live page data, execute awaited JS in srcdoc and cross-origin frame, throw after logging and return nonserializable data; verify output shape, console context, exit code and absence of replay.

capabilities.name: 视口和窗口持久化
capabilities.contract: Narrow viewport survives the next independent CLI connection; headed outer-window size and CSS viewport differ. Extension refusal of emulation must not break unrelated operations.
capabilities.main: Window tool present, cross-process and extension semantics unaccepted.
capabilities.pr27: Live 390x844 setting reverted to 1600x950 on next call; adb retained 390x844.
capabilities.acceptance: Set mobile viewport, navigate and read innerWidth/innerHeight in a fresh CLI process; compare screenshot dimensions and responsive layout, then repeat over extension transport.

capabilities.name: 截图、坐标和图像预算
capabilities.contract: Pixel caps, max-edge, JPEG byte budget and metadata/scale factor define coordinates fed back into input. DPR, clip and full-page screenshots need distinct geometry; sidechannel delivery belongs to consumer acceptance.
capabilities.main: Image cap module and screenshots present; VLM/display round trip is unaccepted.
capabilities.pr27: Basic saved screenshot passed; full image-cap/DPR/click round trip and desktop-sidechannel not accepted.
capabilities.acceptance: Capture high-DPR long page and element image, enforce actual byte/pixel cap, use returned scale to click a marked target; deliver image through real agent consumer and verify rendered preview.

capabilities.name: PDF 纸型、单位与 CSS
capabilities.contract: Preset or explicit dimensional units, margins, CSS preference, validation and pixel-exact page injection; output is a real inspectable PDF, not just a path.
capabilities.main: PDF tool exists; current units/preset surface not proven.
capabilities.pr27: Old parser lacks --paper and unit dimensions; margin/prefer-css-page-size differences recorded.
capabilities.acceptance: Export a designed page with A4 and pixel dimensions, parse PDF MediaBox/page count and render it; verify margins and CSS preference, then invalid units must fail without misleading output file.

capabilities.name: 跨进程录制与证据文件
capabilities.contract: Recorder survives start CLI exit, stop captures the final state, produces replayable artifact and reports invalid/incomplete recording honestly. Repeated stop with the same ID returns the saved result while checking file existence/size; failed recordings cannot be repaired by retrying stop. Tool discovery and extension packaging must expose it.
capabilities.main: Both recording tools absent.
capabilities.pr27: Both recording tools absent; old reference predates recording.
capabilities.acceptance: Start recording in one process, discover/fill/submit a page in later processes, stop and decode frames; verify first/final state and nonzero duration, duplicate-start rejection, idempotent stop, modified-file detection, interrupted recorder and extension transport.

capabilities.name: 下载与 iframe 文件产物
capabilities.contract: Arm download event before click, frame context, authenticated browser fetch, output path/name/size and completion. Do not conflate direct URL download with clicking a blob/download link.
capabilities.main: Download tools exist; iframe and completion semantics need acceptance.
capabilities.pr27: download_link --frame is missing relative to current reference.
capabilities.acceptance: Log into a local fixture, discover a frame download link, click through the returned locator and verify downloaded bytes/hash/name; exercise slow/cancelled download and duplicate filename.

capabilities.name: 在线 cookies、保存与恢复
capabilities.contract: Live extraction includes httpOnly/session cookies and returns a bare list; domain is required. Persisted cookies use current JSON with legacy-load behavior handled explicitly, and startup/close ordering must not overwrite newly loaded login.
capabilities.main: JSON load exists; legacy pickle input is rejected, requiring an explicit old-state conversion strategy.
capabilities.pr27: Documents nonexecuting legacy pickle parser plus retained old cookies_list. Extra alias is intentional, not current adb interface.
capabilities.acceptance: Set HttpOnly/session cookies via fixture server, save and stop, start isolated browser and load, prove authenticated request; test legacy fixture and malformed input, including extension cookie shim.

capabilities.name: 离线 cookies 与系统密钥
capabilities.contract: Locked SQLite, Windows DPAPI, macOS Keychain/Linux decryption and Chrome v20 limitations are distinct paths. All undecryptable matching v20 cookies must fail with live-extraction guidance; partial readable results are explicit.
capabilities.main: Offline/import implementation exists, OS coverage not accepted.
capabilities.pr27: Old parity coverage is not proof for real current user profiles or all operating systems.
capabilities.acceptance: Use disposable logged-in test profiles on each supported OS, extract/import then request protected resource; exercise database lock, missing key store, all-v20 and mixed readable cookies without logging credential values.

capabilities.name: localStorage 与旧版本缺陷
capabilities.contract: Per-origin single-key/batch localStorage and empty values. Current wrappers call obsolete get_local_storage/set_local_storage methods while Tab exposes storage_get/storage_set; do not preserve this failure as desired behavior.
capabilities.main: Storage implementation exists; real round trip is needed.
capabilities.pr27: Documents intentional correction of Python wrapper bug; see live-history-review.json for the newly run comparison.
capabilities.acceptance: Set a draft via tool, reload in a new process and read it via both tool and page UI; separately record old-baseline failure and approved repaired behavior, including empty values and origin isolation.

capabilities.name: 人工登录与持久化登录态
capabilities.contract: Headed manual login, completion/timeout and cookie persistence; a noninteractive agent must receive an actionable path, and a real login refresh must not be replaced by an empty-cookie smoke test.
capabilities.main: Login helper exists, real login acceptance remains open.
capabilities.pr27: Presence of login command does not establish actual provider login or credential reuse.
capabilities.acceptance: Complete a real test-account login in headed browser, save/close and reopen through consumer; verify protected operation, expired login recovery, cancellation and no orphan browser.

capabilities.name: Python CDP/Tab SDK、事件、超时与恢复
capabilities.contract: Async Tab/connection ownership, event subscribe/remove, generator commands and typed results, deep serialization, custom timeout, reconnect/target rediscovery. Timeout replay is opt-in; read/write commands cannot be blindly retried. Raw CDP object/list/enums and acronym names must serialize correctly.
capabilities.main: Rust CDP SDK is not a Python import-compatible replacement; 61 CLI names omit this surface.
capabilities.pr27: Rust APIs documented; deep Python consumers, subclassing/private APIs and monkeypatch remain migration work.
capabilities.acceptance: Run a real async consumer through connect, subscribe, navigation, timed-out mutation and reconnect; count page/server mutation exactly once by default; exercise opt-in safe retry, target replacement and event cleanup.

capabilities.name: 作业池、重试、取消与持久化
capabilities.contract: Generic client async context, queue/priority/held jobs, selectors/shared targets, business success vs exception, typed error bases, retry limit (-1 unlimited), resize/wait/cancel, atomic state JSON. Pending/in_progress overlap and exit cancellation are source behaviors needing explicit correction decisions.
capabilities.main: BrowserPool and Python-compatible job model are absent.
capabilities.pr27: Pool implementation/tests document dedup of restored jobs and graceful worker removal; intentional differences from Python. No real downstream Grok pool acceptance yet.
capabilities.acceptance: Submit real browser jobs, hold/release and prioritize them, fail/retry one, resize while busy, interrupt/save/restart and verify exact job IDs/results without duplicate side effects; run downstream subclass callbacks and cancellation.

capabilities.name: ProfileManager 的 cookie 模式
capabilities.contract: shared/per_worker/temp here select cookie persistence files, not the same concept as Chrome user-data-dir/profile in browser_start. Existing .dat paths and per-worker naming are state migration inputs.
capabilities.main: ProfileManager-compatible API absent.
capabilities.pr27: Rust profile support documented; actual old cookie state and client constructor integration unaccepted.
capabilities.acceptance: Use two workers with shared then per_worker cookie files; verify intended login sharing/isolation, restart persistence and temp cleanup; do not allow simultaneous incompatible writers during cutover.

capabilities.name: CLI 合同、错误、发现与消费者协议
capabilities.contract: Generated name/signature/help/failure hint and raw JSON shape are SSOT. Boolean negation, Literal, list/dict, injected handles, UTF-8, semantic false, exit codes, error_code/retryable, REDIRECT and consumer screenshot/call-ID sidechannel all need explicit contracts.
capabilities.main: 54 of 61 tool names; Windows debug --help startup failure. Main/serve/flow routing are distinct entry points.
capabilities.pr27: 59 of 61 names; old 382-flag check targeted adb v0.38.1. False-result and JS-error mismatches confirmed; current full parser snapshot is in adb-history-inventory.json.
capabilities.acceptance: From real agent tool discovery, choose a tool, execute successful and failing actions, recover from returned hint and display screenshot; compare CLI/flow/serve JSON and exit semantics, Unicode, redirection and consumer sidechannel correlation.

capabilities.name: 发行、安装、资源与来源记录
capabilities.contract: Tag-derived version/build SHA, PyPI wheel/sdist, packaged extension ZIP and checksums, Python/extras/platforms, GitHub release, downstream bundled/submodule install and rollback. Reference license is AGPL-3.0; Rust workspace says MIT; source provenance needs a file-level decision before release.
capabilities.main: Rust build/CI exists; debug Windows CLI crash known, release build not assessed. Package release channels differ from adb.
capabilities.pr27: Three-platform parity CI and separate extension packaging documented; not a clean-install acceptance of current adb replacement.
capabilities.acceptance: Install each signed-off release artifact in clean supported environments, verify version/hash/extension resources, run real browser and recording journey, upgrade then roll back; rebuild downstream desktop distribution and resolve source/license manifest.
